grade_reason: Lean and on point (the one non-optional item, the Thai smuggling suspicion, is kept), but all three records carry the wrong tier and e2 restates e1.
standard_doubt: The tier table has no row for an allegation made by an official party: '正式动作' (row 2, fact) would label a prosecutor's unproven allegation as fact, and '官员的讲话' (row 3) fits only loosely; an analyst wants charges filed recorded as fact and the alleged conduct as party_statement, and the table does not say so.
